event_chain.summary: Network accessed; client files likely taken

summary: Around February 5, 2026 Baton Rouge accounting firm Catalanatto & Barnes CPAs detected unusual network activity. A forensic review completed on June 5 found that files containing names, Social Security numbers and other sensitive financial information had likely been taken by an unauthorized external actor. The firm reported the breach to the Nebraska attorney general and offered 12 months of credit monitoring.
